_about: Hand-written driver facts (State Blob White Paper V1, layer 6). Keyed by the roster's driver_id for humans and by spoken name for AI cars. 'facts' are always offerable (at most three are offered); 'armed' facts are offered only when their condition holds: on_podium, on_lead, on_win, on_retire. Keep every fact true and short; every capitalised word in a fact becomes sayable when it is offered, so no nicknames the driver would not want on air. Empty entries are fine -- this file is optional.

facts: Ronin told us before the race he'd settle for second place, and he's named Valor as the man he most wants to beat.
He's running softs for the entire race, a bold call for Abu Dhabi's long straights.
Ronin is a pilot in real life.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna second was the realistic target, and here he is.
armed.on_win: He came in predicting second, but Ronin has gone one better.
armed.on_retire: He feared that ninety-degree turn onto the long straight, and it may have caught him out.

facts: Valor told us he'll finish first today, and he's named Ronin as the man he most wants to beat.
There's history between Valor and Ronin: Valor says Ronin blocked him in the last race.
Valor predicts Ronin will end up in the wall during this five-lap sprint.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna first place was the target, and here he is.
armed.on_lead: Valor said he'd qualify on pole and lead this race, and that's exactly where he is.
armed.on_win: He called pole position and the win before the race, and he's delivered.

facts: ECX told us he's targeting first place today, and named Valor as the driver he most wants to beat.
This is ECX's first race in the league, and he says he's here to shake things up.
ECX is running a setup with extra downforce, leaning towards grip over straight-line speed.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna first place was the target, and here he is on debut.
armed.on_win: ECX called his shot before the race: first place, and he's delivered on his very first outing.
armed.on_retire: ECX said that sharp left-hander early in the lap worried him, and it may have caught him out.

facts: Shockin told us he's aiming for first and plans to show everyone the rear view of his car all day.
He named Ronin as his main rival and predicted Ronin will be too aggressive and crash into the wall.
Shockin has been away working on other projects and says he's still getting back up to speed.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna he was aiming for first, and here he is.
armed.on_lead: He said the plan was to show everyone the rear view of his car all day, and that's exactly what's happening.
armed.on_win: He called first place before the race, and he's delivered.
